text.title: SEO Techniques Worked Example
text.summary: One end-to-end worked example of SEO Techniques producing a valid checklist artefact, anonymised for portability. Then the technique reference: JSON-LD schema patterns for Article, FAQ, Organization, and Breadcrumb types with validation workflow. llms.txt standard for AI crawler guidance, entity optimization, and content structure for AI citation. Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tag requirements, pillar-cluster internal linking structure, and keyword cannibalization fixes.

step.name: trigger
step.text: Engagement onboarded; the SEO Techniques methodology was selected after Applies-If was satisfied (named owner Ruslan Faion, downstream consumer engagement charter, source-of-truth in docs/).

step.name: apply-rules
step.text: Walked the rules from 01-core-rules.xml. First-pass review surfaced one violation (missing evidence anchor on a non-trivial field); patched and re-ran.

step.name: produce
step.text: Filled templates/schema-validation-checklist.md per the schema in content/02-output-contract.xml; emitted artefact_id with date; signed off by the engagement owner.

step.name: validate
step.text: Ran scripts/validate-seo-techniques.py --file <path>; validator returned 0; the _smoke-test.md fixture also passed.

text.example: Applies-If held; inputs reachable; rules walked; artefact filled; validator returned 0; owner signed off; downstream consumer registered.

list.item: Organization + Person: brand and author entity (global, add to header/footer)
Article/BlogPosting: all editorial content with author and datePublished
FAQPage: Q&A sections, "People Also Ask" style content
HowTo: step-by-step tutorials
BreadcrumbList: all pages with 2+ level hierarchy
Product + Offer: e-commerce product pages

example.title: Required fields by schema type

list.item: Article: headline, author (@type Person, name), publisher, datePublished, image
FAQPage: mainEntity array of Question + acceptedAnswer pairs
Organization: name, url, logo (ImageObject), sameAs array
BreadcrumbList: itemListElement array with ListItem, position, name, item (URL)

example.note: The last BreadcrumbList item (current page) should have a name but no item URL. Including a URL for the current page is technically valid but not required.

list.item: File location: https://yourdomain.com/llms.txt
Content: site description, core pages, product pages, contact, exclusions
Format: Markdown, starting with # sitename and a brief description line
Update: when site structure changes significantly
Brand entity: Organization schema on every page, sameAs links to social profiles
Author entity: Person schema with sameAs links to LinkedIn, Twitter, GitHub
Product entities: consistent naming in all descriptions, meta, and schema
Relationship entities: explicitly link "Author X works at Organization Y" in schema

section.title: Social meta tags

list.item: og:title: page title (max 60 chars for optimal display)
og:description: 155-160 chars, compelling summary
og:image: absolute URL, 1200x630px, under 8MB
og:image:alt: image description for accessibility
og:url: canonical URL (must match rel=canonical)
og:type: website (default) or article (for blog posts)
og:locale: en_US (or appropriate locale)
twitter:card: summary_large_image for articles and content
twitter:title: max 70 chars
twitter:description: max 200 chars
twitter:image: minimum 506x506px (use the 1200x630 OG image)
twitter:creator: author Twitter handle
twitter:site: brand Twitter handle
